cohort: 50 babies born between February and August 2022 at Vinayaka Mission Medical College, Karaikal, Pondicherry, India
finding: A UCB cutoff of 1.95 mg/dL had a sensitivity of 75% and specificity of 68% for predicting significant jaundice requiring phototherapy, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.765 (95% CI 0.592-0.937).
